stories.story_fr: Le carnet de commandes Electrical Americas d'Eaton bondit de 18% sur un an a des niveaux records au Q4 2023, porté par la demande des data centers, du machinery OEM et des marchés institutionnels, signal d'une visibilité durable sur la croissance.
stories.story_en: Eaton's Electrical Americas backlog jumped 18% year on year to record levels in Q4 2023, driven by data center, machinery OEM and institutional market demand, a signal of durable growth visibility.
stories.quote: Backlog at the end of December remains at record levels, up 18% organically over December 2022 ... with growth in the data center, machinery OEM and institutional markets.

stories.story_fr: La marge opérationnelle Electrical Americas atteint un record de 28,5% au Q4 2023, en hausse de 480 points de base sur un an, démontrant un levier opérationnel exceptionnel sur la vague d'électrification.
stories.story_en: Electrical Americas operating margin hit a record 28.5% in Q4 2023, up 480 basis points year on year, showing exceptional operating leverage on the electrification wave.
stories.quote: Operating margins in the quarter were a record 28.5%, up 480 basis points over the fourth quarter of 2022.

stories.story_fr: Eaton investit plus d'un milliard de dollars dans ses capacités de production pour répondre a la demande tirée par l'électrification, la transition énergétique et la digitalisation.
stories.story_en: Eaton is investing more than $1 billion of capital in manufacturing to meet demand driven by electrification, energy transition and digitalization.
stories.quote: we are investing more than $1 billion of capital in manufacturing to support the growth driven by electrification, energy transition and digitalization.

stories.story_fr: Les ratios book-to-bill restent solides au Q4 2023, au-dessus de 1,1 pour l'électrique et a 1,1 pour l'aéronautique, signe que les commandes continuent de dépasser les livraisons et nourrissent le carnet.
stories.story_en: Book-to-bill ratios stayed strong in Q4 2023, above 1.1 for Electrical and 1.1 for Aerospace, a sign that orders keep outpacing shipments and feeding the backlog.
stories.quote: On a rolling twelve-month basis, the book-to-bill ratio for the Electrical businesses remained strong at over 1.1 ... the book-to-bill ratio for the Aerospace segment remained strong at 1.1.

stories.story_fr: Le carnet Aerospace progresse de 13% sur un an au Q4 2023, soutenu par une forte demande en commercial OEM, aftermarket commercial et aftermarket défense.
stories.story_en: Aerospace backlog grew 13% year on year in Q4 2023, supported by strong demand in commercial OEM, commercial aftermarket and defense aftermarket.
stories.quote: The twelve-month rolling average of orders in the fourth quarter was up 7% organically, with particular strength in commercial OEM, commercial aftermarket and defense aftermarket. The backlog at the end of December was up 13% over December 2022.
